decision: Freeze families and controls before execution; no tuning after validation.
semantics: Boolean independent-set counting through identical nonnegative pair factors
accounting: All acquisition trials, including unavailable trials, charged once to each learned lifecycle; each query pays preparation, attempted proposal and fixed fallback. Repeat phases are explicit, not new unique holdouts. Independent truth enumeration and verification exported separately.
prohibitions: No benchmark metadata supplied to planner
